description: Pinned bubblewrap source staged into every Linux package's codex-resources directory, so a packaged CLI can sandbox tools even where no system bwrap is installed (Rust codex-resources/bwrap). The digest is the published release asset's SHA-256 and identifies the input, not security or license approval.
purpose: Sandbox launcher the packaged CLI runs when no system bwrap is on PATH (Rust linux-sandbox::bundled_bwrap)

buildTools.name: meson
buildTools.purpose: Build program required to compile bubblewrap

buildTools.name: ninja
buildTools.purpose: Backend meson drives; also used for the packaged voice codec
